name: private-requests
description: Proof (#843): an embedded Better Auth provider in one local URLCode site.

scripts.validate: urlcode validate --local --project app --host-file host.mjs --policy operator/policy.json --origin http://localhost:4180
scripts.test: urlcode test --project app --host-file host.mjs --policy operator/policy.json --origin http://localhost:4180
scripts.audit: urlcode audit --expect-routes 8 --project app --host-file host.mjs --policy operator/policy.json --origin http://localhost:4180
scripts.start: urlcode serve --project app --host-file host.mjs --policy operator/policy.json --origin http://localhost:4180 --port 4180
